page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated physical cores with 12 vCPUs, offering a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance dichotomy between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 10% to 25% tier. Similarly, single-threaded operations like gzip compression and text processing are weak. However, multi-core benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, achieve average mid-tier performance. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register in the average range, though the Passmark memory score is comparatively weak.

Given its high memory density of 8 GB per vCPU, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand top-tier single-thread compute speeds. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures stable multi-threaded execution. It is suitable for database operations, Redis caching layers, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks, while being less optimal for single-threaded applications, high-throughput web serving, or large-scale LLM inference.
